name: STDEVP
description: STDEVP calculates the standard deviation based on an entire population, using the n denominator. It is the legacy compatibility version of STDEV.P.
tldr: Population standard deviation (n) of a set of numbers.

parameters.name: number1
parameters.description: The first number, range, or reference in the population.

parameters.name: number2
parameters.description: Additional numbers, ranges, or references (optional, up to 255 total arguments).

basicExample.description: Population standard deviation of five values
basicExample.explanation: The mean is 30; the population variance is 200 (sum of squared deviations 1000 divided by 5) and its square root is 14.14213562.

advancedExamples.title: Population from a range
advancedExamples.scenario: Full census of a small group
advancedExamples.description: Compute the spread of every value in B2:B6
advancedExamples.result: Population standard deviation of the 5 values
advancedExamples.explanation: Divides by n (5) rather than n-1.

advancedExamples.title: Population vs sample
advancedExamples.explanation: STDEVP divides by 5 (n) while STDEV divides by 4 (n-1), so the sample version is larger.

howItWorks: STDEVP computes the population variance as the sum of squared deviations from the mean divided by n, then takes the square root. Using n (not n-1) is correct only when the supplied data is the complete population; for a sample, STDEV's n-1 correction is appropriate. Text and logical values in references are ignored.

howToSteps.name: Confirm population
howToSteps.text: Ensure the data represents the entire population, not a sample.

howToSteps.name: Press Enter
howToSteps.text: The population standard deviation is displayed.

limitations: Only valid when the data is the entire population; using it on a sample underestimates the true spread.
Ignores text and logical values inside ranged references.
Requires at least one numeric value, otherwise returns #DIV/0!.

commonErrors.fix: Provide at least one data point.

commonErrors.cause: Data was actually a sample but n was used.
commonErrors.fix: Use STDEV (or STDEV.S) for a sample.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: STDEVP behaves the same in Google Sheets as a population standard deviation.

faq.question: What is the difference between STDEVP and STDEV?
faq.answer: STDEVP divides by n (population), STDEV divides by n-1 (sample).

faq.question: Is STDEVP the same as STDEV.P?
faq.answer: Functionally yes; STDEV.P is the modern replacement for the legacy STDEVP.

faq.question: Does STDEVP include text in cells?
faq.answer: No. Use STDEVPA if you want text counted as 0 and TRUE counted as 1.
